title: framework.config.json
description: The ONE config the framework reads from the app repo (plan D3/D5-D8). The framework never assumes where it lives; everything app-scoped is declared here.

framework.description: Pin/version metadata for the installed agentic-lifecycle distribution.

source.description: git+https URL or index used to install the pin

app_root.description: Application root, relative to this config file (or absolute). '.' means the config's own directory.

state_folder.description: GSD state root, relative to app_root (or absolute). Plan D3 uses '.framework/state'.

gate_settings.description: Gate behaviour overrides (browser output dir, environment bindings).

surface.description: How the framework surface (agents/skills/rules/commands) is injected at OpenCode config-build time.

readiness.description: App-specific paths the readiness checks and the gates target (Phase A step 4). Omitted keys fall back to the repo-root defaults in framework/locate.py, which is only correct when the application IS the repository root.

python_types_dir.description: Directory gen_types.py writes Python contract types into, relative to app_root. G1 diffs this path for drift, so it must be the directory the backend actually imports from.

typescript_types_dir.description: Directory gen_types.py writes TypeScript contract types into, relative to app_root. G1 diffs this path for drift, so it must be the directory the frontend actually imports from.

frontend_globs.description: Globs G5 treats as frontend source, relative to app_root. Declare these when the app's layout differs from the stack contract's src/frontend default (e.g. a Next.js app under web/src).

primitive_dirs.description: Directories exempt from G5's raw-element rules (the shadcn primitive directory), relative to app_root.
